0022600178.text: The Indiana Pacers (2-6, 12th in the East) are on the road against the Memphis Grizzlies (6-1, 2nd in the West), with Indiana on a five-game losing streak and Memphis coming off its only loss of the season. Indiana is without Tyrese Haliburton, Kelly Oubre Jr., Ben Sheppard, Johnny Furphy and T.J. McConnell, while Memphis is missing Scotty Pippen Jr. The teams have not played yet in 2026-27, and the Pacers lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 125-106 in Indianapolis on March 1, 2026.
